# eon_source_account_metrics_config (Resource)

Manages the job metrics configuration of a source account. When enabled, Eon publishes job metrics to the configured destination (for example CloudWatch). The configuration is a singleton per source account; deleting this resource disables metrics for the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Configure CloudWatch metrics for a source account
resource "eon_source_account_metrics_config" "aws" {
  source_account_id = eon_source_account.aws_production.id

  aws {
    region = "us-east-1"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the source account whose metrics configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `aws` (Block, Optional) AWS metrics destination. Set when publishing metrics to CloudWatch in the source account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--aws))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the source account. Mirrors `source_account_id`.

<a id="nestedblock--aws"></a>
### Nested Schema for `aws`

Optional:

- `region` (String) CloudWatch region to publish metrics to.
